basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software engineer based in Seattle with a passion for gaming and anime. I've been an avid Monster Hunter player since the third generation and love discussing game strategies and builds. When I'm not slaying monsters, I'm usually watching anime or exploring new tech innovations. My typical online hours are during the evenings and weekends, as my job keeps me busy during the day. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in Monster Hunter World comes from years of dedicated gameplay and participation in community discussions. I frequently experiment with different builds and strategies, often sharing my findings with others. My background in software engineering also gives me a knack for understanding game mechanics and optimizing performance.
